evidence.observation: At 14:05:12Z auth-gateway deployed change AUTH-2026-0318 setting jwks_namespace=partner-v2 and issuer=partner-v2. At 14:08:34Z validation failed because token_issuer=partner-v2 while allowed_issuers remained partner-v1.
payment-api rejected checkout request req-8812 because auth-gateway returned issuer_not_allowed / invalid_issuer before any order-db dependency was used.
checkout-web user-facing failures were 401s from upstream payment-api with explicit invalid issuer/auth_failed messages during submit_order.

At 14:10Z auth-gateway had elevated 401s (28.4%) with note 'jwks cache miss and issuer mismatch'; payment-api had elevated 401s (21.2%) with note 'auth dependency returning invalid issuer'; checkout-web also spiked to 18.7% 401s.
The dependency chain is checkout-web -> payment-api -> auth-gateway, and AUTH-2026-0318 is the only recent auth-gateway change listed near the incident window.

excluded_red_herrings.why_not_primary_cause: orders-db showed cpu=86 during vacuum, but query latency stayed normal (p95 35ms), errors stayed at 0, and logs state failing checkout request req-8812 never reached orders-db.
The CDN issue was isolated to static images. checkout-web logs say static assets served normally after retry while the checkout flow remained blocked by payment auth failures.
These are downstream symptoms. checkout-web logs attribute failures to upstream payment-api auth_failed invalid issuer responses rather than a local regression.

recommended_next_steps: Mitigate immediately by restoring auth-gateway allowed_issuers to include partner-v2 or rolling back AUTH-2026-0318.
Purge or rebuild the partner-v2 JWKS cache namespace after the issuer allowlist is corrected.
Verify recovery by confirming auth-gateway issuer_not_allowed errors stop, payment-api invalid_issuer rejections drop to baseline, and checkout-web submit_order 401s clear.
Add a deployment guard that validates issuer configuration and allowlist consistency before auth-gateway rollout.
